messages:
emma_partnerships: Heads up — we need to lock partner fund splits for QBR next Tue. Can people confirm scorecard owners and final MDF slate by EOD Friday? Need marketplace co-marketing caps and SI integration credits allocated.
raj_sales: Quick Q — do we prioritize cloud marketplace promos or SI enablement? my gut says SI enablement for top 6, marketplace for next tier.
lina_pm: timeline note: QBR deck due Monday COB. If we don't have final numbers by Friday, we'll have to show provisional numbers and mark as 'TBD'.
marco_finance: putting a baseline here — current pool: $250k MDF, $120k co-marketing, reserved buffer $30k. Suggest allocation draft:
```
SI enablement: $120000
Marketplace promos: $90000
Co-marketing reserved: $30000
Buffer: $10000
```
jen_ops: Approval process — legal needs partner SOWs before MDF is committed. I can run a parallel checklist with partner ops templates.
emma_partnerships: @marco_finance can you post the allocation spreadsheet link? also we should include scorecard KPIs: pipeline $ generated, integration milestones, joint announcements scheduled.
marco_finance: spreadsheet: https://redwood.in/sheets/partner-fund-q2 (access: partners-read). Updated numbers are in tab 'alloc-v2'.
raj_sales: added my top-6 SI nominations in the sheet. Noted a request for co-funding for an APAC pilot — flagging for review.
lina_pm: scorecard owners: i'll take marketplace scorecard, emma you'll own SI enablement scorecard? also need someone for announcements cadence.
emma_partnerships: happy to own announcements cadence. jen_ops can you confirm legal SLAs for SOW review? we may need to push partners to sign within 5 business days.
jen_ops: confirmed — 5 biz days is tight but doable for standard SOWs. I'll draft an email template to speed up signatures.
mdf_bot: Reminder — MDF approval pipeline has 3 pending items older than 72h. See /mdf queue.
emma_partnerships: action items: 1) marco finalize allocations and share final sheet by Fri 10am; 2) raj confirm SI nomination priority and expected ARR impact; 3) jen ops share SOW template by Thu; 4) lina produce provisional QBR slide with 'TBD' callouts if needed.
raj_sales: noted — I'll add ARR estimates and drop comments inline.
marco_finance: will push final numbers by Fri 9:45am UTC, with version tag alloc-final.
lina_pm: I'll build QBR deck slides and mark items with 'needs approval' sticker.
emma_partnerships: thanks all. if nobody objects, I'll schedule a 30m sync Friday 11am to ratify allocations. :calendar:
raj_sales: :thumbsup:
jen_ops: :eyes:
mdf_bot: Auto-archiver: thread will be tagged 'partner-fund' once final allocs posted.
emma_partnerships: great — closing for now. ping if anything changes.
